note: Original text for the house and planet characters. No model is called: greetings, replies, and emotes rotate through these lines, and a hint is the first entry in `hints` whose condition still holds. Places are floor rectangles (center and size in metres, x and z). Positions are in metres; `face` is the point a character looks at until the player comes near.

greet: Mrrow. You found the front door. The hall is just inside.
Back again? I kept your spot warm on the step.
Psst. The witch is stirring something in the hall. Smells like pumpkins.
reply: I only answer to treats. And to my name. You said my name.
I've walked every room in this house. Hall, passage, gallery. Then a nap.
Don't tell the ghost, but I'm the one who knocks the candles over.

emote.text: chases her own tail in a little circle
hops up and flicks her tail

greet: Welcome, welcome! Mind the cauldron, it bites.
Ah, a visitor. The house likes visitors. It eats the quiet ones.
You're just in time. I need someone to taste this.
reply: Eye of newt, a pinch of moonlight, and an orange you'd rather not ask about.
This house can be anything you want. Choose Edit and tell it so.
Every pumpkin in here was carved by me. Well, most of them.

emote.text: sweeps off her hat and bows low
waves her ladle with a flourish

greet: Oooh. You made it all the way to the gallery.
Don't be scared. I'm mostly sheet.
Welcome to my gallery. The werewolf is a friend. Mostly.
reply: I've haunted this house for a hundred years. It's cozier than it looks.
Can you keep a secret? The werewolf's face can be repainted. Select him and try it.

hints.text: Walk through the front door into the hall. Click the world to look around, and use W, A, S, and D to walk.
At the far end of the hall there's a narrow passage. Follow it to the gallery.
Have you met the witch? She's by the cauldron in the hall.
Someone floats around the gallery, past the passage. Go and say hello.
Now make the house your own. Choose Edit to move a pumpkin or ask Jarvis for a change, then publish it and share it with a friend.

greet: Hello, neighbour! This courtyard is all yours.
Lovely light today. Perfect for planting something.
Oh, it's you. I was just talking to the hedges.
reply: A courtyard is like a garden. Start small and it grows.
Soft pastels suit this place, but you can change the style any time.
If you're looking for me, I'll be near the middle with my watering can.

greet: Well met, traveller. This is your ground now.
Quiet out here. Good for thinking, and for building.
You walk softly. You'd make a fine ranger.
reply: I keep watch over these walls. Nothing gets past me but the wind.
Every world starts as an empty field. What you build is up to you.
The far wall has the best view of the sky at dusk.

emote.text: touches the brim of his hat

hints.text: Walk the whole courtyard first. Head for the far wall and look back.
Open Your courtyard to change the style and the hour. Then choose Edit to place things, and Save project when you like it.
